annotations.title: The shortest documented chain of literary influence between two authors

description: For 'how is X connected to Y', 'did X influence Y', 'trace the influence from X to Y'. Shortest chain of documented influence links (Wikidata 'influenced by' plus model-attested) through 77 authors, each link with its direction, source and how alike the two authors' texts are. Says plainly when no chain exists or an author is not in the network.
name: influence_chain
title: The shortest documented chain of literary influence between two authors
